missing.fact: Soul Booster's internal item identifier is item_soul_booster.
The component identifiers are Point Booster (item_point_booster), Vitality Booster (item_vitality_booster), and Energy Booster (item_energy_booster).
The items it builds into have the identifiers Khanda (item_angels_demise), Bloodstone (item_bloodstone), Crella's Crozier (item_crellas_crozier), and Octarine Core (item_octarine_core).
